sentences.en: The polio vaccine was first produced by an American scientist.
sentences.zh: 第一个接种脊髓灰质炎疫苗的是美国科学家。

sentences.en: We have to work at the laboratory on researching the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在实验室里研究这种疫苗。

sentences.en: Mennad doesn't know what the side effects of the vaccine are.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德不知道这种疫苗的副作用是什么。
